additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, mr. Yacine raised this ticket about a IMD_BC1 error which makes the Outlet 1 out of order. Right now, it is not present but I checked the last week and it seems like a recurrent issue:
Please go on-site and check the modbus connection of the IMD:
If the error still persists, please trial swapping BC1 and BC2, if the error persists in the former BC1, then please replace it as it should not be a problem with the cables.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0441349 ﻿from the
